        Data attribution
        ----------------
        This MCP wraps public APIs:
        
        * UniProt REST API — UniProt Consortium (European Bioinformatics Institute,
          SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics, Protein Information Resource).
          https://www.uniprot.org/help/programmatic_access
          No API key required for moderate traffic.
        
        * RCSB PDB Data API — RCSB Protein Data Bank, a member of the Worldwide
          Protein Data Bank partnership.
          https://data.rcsb.org/
          No API key required; documented at https://www.rcsb.org/docs/programmatic-access
        
        Use of these APIs does not imply endorsement by UniProt or RCSB. This MCP
        performs no structural or biological interpretation — it returns public
        records verbatim. Downstream tools must not present the outputs as scientific
        advice or annotation.
